# opnsense_kea_ctrl_agent (Resource)

Kea control agent (Services > Kea DHCP > Control Agent), the REST endpoint Kea high availability peers use to talk to each other. This is a singleton that always exists, so it must be imported before Terraform manages it (`id = "kea_ctrl_agent"`); destroying it only removes it from state. Attributes left unset keep the current value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
import {
  to = opnsense_kea_ctrl_agent.this
  id = "kea_ctrl_agent"
}

# Let the HA peer reach this firewall's control agent over the sync link.
resource "opnsense_kea_ctrl_agent" "this" {
  enabled   = true
  http_host = "10.255.255.1"
  http_port = 8000
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Run the control agent. Required for Kea HA (`opnsense_kea_dhcpv4_peer`). OPNsense only starts it while Kea DHCPv4 or DHCPv6 is enabled.
- `http_host` (String) Address the agent listens on; HA peers must be able to reach it.
- `http_port` (Number) Port the agent listens on.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `kea_ctrl_agent`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The singleton always has this ID
terraform import opnsense_kea_ctrl_agent.this kea_ctrl_agent
```
